mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=P.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=P.device_id AND NOW() >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR NOW() <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE P.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND ( X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(NOW())+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(NOW())=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(NOW()) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(NOW()) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(NOW()) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=P.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=P.device_id AND P.event_dt >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR P.event_dt <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE P.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND ( X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(P.event_dt)+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(P.event_dt)=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(P.event_dt) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(P.event_dt) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(P.event_dt) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )

CONCAT('WEB-P-',P.PERF_EVENT_SN) AS dsbltyNo, P.PERF_EVENT_SN AS eventSeq, P.EMS_ID AS emsId, P.DEVICE_ID AS souEqpmntId, COALESCE(E.device_nm,P.DEVICE_ID) AS eqpmntNm,P.DEVICE_ID AS eqpmntMngNo, E.device_ip AS ipAddr,E.device_type AS eqpmntSeCd, E.device_station AS instlPlcNm,E.device_station AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, CONCAT(T.THRSHLD_PROFILE_NM,' / ',CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU' ELSE 'MEMORY' END) AS dsbltyTypeNm, CONCAT(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU' ELSE 'MEMORY' END, ' 사용률 ',P.LAST_VALUE,'% 임계치 초과') AS dsbltyOcrnCn, CAST(P.EVENT_GRADE AS CHAR) AS gatewayGrade, P.EVENT_DT AS dsbltyOcrnDt, P.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, P.EVENT_EDT AS dsbltyEndDt, CASE P.EVENT_GRADE WHEN 1 THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 3 THEN 'LOW' WHEN 4 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN 5 THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'CLEAR' END AS dsbltyGrdCd, CASE P.EVENT_GRADE WHEN 1 THEN '긴급' WHEN 2 THEN '높음' WHEN 3 THEN '낮음' WHEN 4 THEN '경고' WHEN 5 THEN '정보' ELSE '해제' END AS dsbltyGrdNm, (SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=P.EMS_ID) AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,E.stn_cd AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm, 'UNCONFIRMED' AS prcsSttsCd,'미확인' AS prcsSttsNm, 'WEB_THRESHOLD' AS dataSource, 'N' AS tempActionYn, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,P.EVENT_DT,NOW()) AS elapsedSec

JOIN web_thrshld_info T ON T.THRSHLD_SN=P.THRSHLD_SN LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=P.EMS_ID AND E.device_id=P.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(SELECT SM.link_sys_cd FROM vw_tnms_system_map SM WHERE SM.ems_id=P.EMS_ID)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM web_perf_thrshld_event P WHERE P.EVENT_YN=1 ORDER BY P.EVENT_DT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT FROM web_perf_thrshld_event P WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY P.EVENT_DT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT FAULT_KEY AS faultKey,DSBLTY_JGMT_CD AS dsbltyJgmtCd, PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd,DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS dsbltyOcrnCn,DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, IDNTY_USER_ID AS idntyUserId,MGMT_MEMO_CN AS mgmtMemoCn,TEMP_ACTION_YN AS tempActionYn,COMPLETE_YN AS completeYn FROM web_fault_process_info WHERE FAULT_KEY=#{_parameter}

SELECT FAULT_KEY AS faultKey,DSBLTY_JGMT_CD AS dsbltyJgmtCd, PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd,DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS dsbltyOcrnCn,DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, TEMP_ACTION_YN AS tempActionYn,COMPLETE_YN AS completeYn FROM web_fault_process_info WHERE FAULT_KEY IN #{id}

SELECT ACTION_SN AS actnSn,ACTN_SE_CD AS actnSeCd,ACTN_CN AS actnCn, SYMPTOM AS symptom,REASON AS reason,RESULT_CN AS result,PLAN AS plan, ACTOR_ID AS actorId,ACTOR_NAME AS actorName,ACTN_DT AS actnDt FROM web_fault_process_action WHERE FAULT_KEY=#{_parameter} ORDER BY ACTN_DT,ACTION_SN
